mounting: Head/socket and support/bay frames are separate; 3D frames preserve authored hanger tilt.
conversion: Original components. Heads remain at authored scale. Separate beams have explicit unit-axis normalization and pole tops an explicit upper_end fit. Loose straight poles use original stripe pitch and rear-housing grey; 300 mm arrow lens UVs reuse authored 200 mm arrow registration. Original FBX unchanged.
shared_components: Bare heads omit only the connected 5 mm source backboard. Double boards widen that original board; housing, lenses and UV registrations keep their authored dimensions.
loose_mounting_foot: All 112 original triangles of Cylinder.052, rigid transform only; no clipping, normalization or invented crossbar.
double_mounting_foot: All 180 original Cylinder.053 triangles, rigid transform only. Its centre bar joins the original Cylinder.052 upright, lowered by the authored bar-to-socket distance; neither foot is stretched.
